### Problem

What are you trying to do, and what gets in the way today?

### Proposal

What should Fab OS do? If it touches identity, packaging, the agent's policy, updates or the image build,
say which ADR in `docs/decisions/` it relates to or whether it needs a new one.

### Alternatives

Other ways to solve it, including "do nothing" or an upstream (Ubuntu / KDE) change.

### Constraints to keep in mind

- No Canonical, KDE or Mozilla trademarks or artwork in Fab OS assets (`legal/TRADEMARKS.md`).
- Attribution and upstream About dialogs are never rebranded (`legal/PATCHED-BINARIES.md`).
- No telemetry; AI stays off until the user turns it on (`legal/PRIVACY.md`).
